description: A stereo chorus and tremolo, with a second, slower movement laid over the chorus modulation

params.text: The speed of the modulation, from 0.01 to 5
How far the modulation moves the delay, -1 to +1
The depth of the slower movement laid over the modulation, -1 to +1
How much of the chorused signal is fed back into the delay, 0 to 1
The balance between the dry signal and the chorused one, 0 to 1
Chooses the wave the modulation uses, from the four shapes drawn beside it
Passes the inputs straight to the outputs with no chorus

inputs.text: A CV changing the modulation speed
A CV changing the modulation depth
A CV changing the depth of the slower movement
A CV changing the dry to chorused balance
A CV changing the output boost
A pulse switches the bypass on and off
A CV changing the tremolo depth
An external signal driving the tremolo in place of its own modulation
